mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy heads towards a potential recession.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, indicating a tight monetary policy, and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the higher cost of borrowing weighs on economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are declining and retail sales (RSAFS) are also falling, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both declining, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) over 3 consecutive months, indicating a weakening labor market, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending power diminishes.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declining for 3 months, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and rising, indicating strong supply-side momentum, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies benefit from increased production and sales.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 12-mo MA and rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is falling, it signals a highly accommodative monetary policy that will boost asset prices, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL falling, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of triggered instances.
